cfg.title: Top MeSH category lifepaths
cfg.sub: Each dot is one higher-level MeSH disease category, made by adding up the monthly mentions of every term that sits under it in the MeSH disease tree. The categories are the second level of the tree path (the level below "Diseases"), for example Infections or Nervous System Diseases, and the subcategories are the third level. A term with several tree paths is counted in each of its categories, so categories overlap; terms that are not in the Diseases tree are added up as one separate category. Phases, thresholds and views work as for single diseases. A category curve is a sum, so it mixes the timing of its member terms: read it as when the area as a whole drew attention.
